summary_en: K891 Corporation launched a tender offer for all ordinary shares of Leopalace21 at 1,000 yen per share and specified warrants at 99,900 yen each, with a 30-business-day period from September 15 to October 30, 2026. The board of directors expressed support for the offer and recommended shareholders and warrant holders to tender, with the aim of making Leopalace21 a wholly-owned subsidiary and delisting from the Prime Market.
title_en: Notice of Expression of Support and Recommendation for Tender Offer for Shares and Warrants by K891 Corporation and Notice of Share Transfer Accompanying Change in Subsidiary
translation_en_brief:
K891 Corporation, a wholly-owned subsidiary of K892 Corporation (itself wholly owned by Kotsutransmission Co., Ltd.), initiated a tender offer for all ordinary shares of Leopalace21 Corporation at 1,000 yen per share. The offer also covers three series of stock warrants (subscription rights issued in 2016, 2017, and 2018) priced at 99,900 yen each. The tender period runs for 30 business days from September 15 to October 30, 2026.

The Board of Directors of Leopalace21 expressed support for the offer and recommended that shareholders and warrant holders tender their securities. The board decision was premised on K891's intention to make Leopalace21 a wholly-owned subsidiary and to delist the company's shares from the Prime Market following the tender offer and related procedures.

As part of the transaction, Leopalace21's board also authorized a capital restructuring of its subsidiary Asuka Shotan Insurance Co., Ltd., converting all issued ordinary shares into Class A shares (voting) and Class B shares (non-voting), with a portion of the Class A shares to be transferred to Insurant Group Co., Ltd., a consolidated subsidiary of Kotsutransmission.
